name: ProjectSphere
description: Enterprise-grade MERN stack platform for managing academic projects with authentication, role-based access control, analytics dashboards, and cloud file management.

paragraphs: A centralized, role-based academic portal that digitalizes the complete lifecycle of final year projects —
from proposal submission to final delivery — for Students, Faculty, HOD, and Administrators.
📖 Overview | 💻 Tech Stack | 🔄 Workflows & Approvals | ✨ Dashboards & Mobile UX | 🛠️ Subsystems | ⚡ Performance | ⚙️ Setup | 🌐 API Routes

whatItDoes.text: A centralized, role-based academic portal that digitalizes the complete lifecycle of final year projects —

requirements.text: Faculty FAB: Quick register button on mobile devices. 🛡️ Admin Control Center Global project pipeline overview User status management (verified, banned, pending) Active login and file upload logs Institutional announcement manager Responsive Tables: Overflow-scroll wrappers for multi-column user grids.
Token Authentication: Implements secure stateless login with JWT access tokens and refresh tokens.
